# skycloak_cluster_builds (Data Source)

Image build history for a cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_cluster_builds" "production" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.

### Read-Only

- `builds` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--builds))

<a id="nestedatt--builds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `builds`

Read-Only:

- `completed_at` (String) Completion time (RFC 3339).
- `error` (String) Failure detail, when failed.
- `id` (String) Build ID.
- `phase` (String) Current build phase.
- `progress` (Number) Percentage complete.
- `started_at` (String) Start time (RFC 3339).
- `status` (String) Build status.
